verdict.rationale: Bento's own docs describe AI-driven insights drawn from the user's trace data inside the product. It clusters similar findings so patterns surface on their own, judges alert incidents as real or benign, pinpoints what shifted when agent behavior drifts, and keeps a plain-language memory of failure patterns. For suggestions, it describes fixes and nudges that run in shadow mode and graduate to full traffic only once they prove they help. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed docs on how suggestions/fixes are generated and shown in the UI, and anything beyond marketing-level descriptions of the insight features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Similar findings group into clusters, so patterns surface before you go looking.
See when your agent starts behaving differently — Bento pinpoints exactly what shifted.
A living memory of what your agent has learned — every failure pattern, fix, and outcome, in plain language.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.
Bento groups fires into incidents and judges each one real or benign
